name: Poland
first_steps: Identify the locality under its historical and current names.
Use the State Archives genealogy guide and Szukaj w Archiwach to locate relevant series.
Discover civil-office and religious custodians for holdings not in the archive catalogue.
jurisdiction_questions: Which partition, state or border applied when the record was created?
Which record languages and calendars occur in the actual series?
Is the current custodian outside Poland?

limits: This is an original starter profile, not a complete country guide or a list of confirmed holdings for any person.
Identify the event locality, period and record creator; verify survival, transfers, indexing and image access with the custodian.
Expand beyond these seeds through regional, municipal, religious, institutional and private finding aids. Do not infer birthplace, religion or ancestry from a name.
